items.sense: Edible vegetable oil represented by current culinary Ulei.
items.rationale: DOOM explicitly supplies the edible-vegetable-oil distinction. Together these establish the intended owner sense despite the broader bare-language word ulei.

items.scope_limit: One singular input only. Variety plural, articulated/case forms, undelemn and hyphenated spellings are not admitted.
